description: Agent-based diffusion of mask-wearing on a social/contact network with household, media, and policy influences. Individuals update daily mask use decisions based on peers, media exposure, policy enforcement/communication, perceived risk, and habit persistence. Encounters occur at home, work/school, and public locations where mandates may be enforced.

modules.name: PopulationInitializer
modules.description: Assigns Person attributes, initial adoption states, anti-masker and influencer roles, and base sensitivities.

update_rule.pseudocode:
on setup:
  set RNG seed
  sample age_group ~ Categorical(age_group_probs)
  sample socioeconomic_status ~ Categorical(ses_distribution)
  sample risk_attitude ~ TruncatedNormal(risk_attitude_mean, risk_attitude_std, 0,1)
  sample trust_in_authority ~ TruncatedNormal(trust_in_authority_mean, 0.15, 0,1)
  sample trust_in_media ~ TruncatedNormal(trust_in_media_mean, 0.15, 0,1)
  sample peer_influence_sensitivity ~ Beta(peer_sensitivity_alpha, peer_sensitivity_beta)
  sample media_influence_sensitivity ~ Beta(media_sensitivity_alpha, media_sensitivity_beta)
  sample policy_influence_sensitivity ~ Beta(policy_sensitivity_alpha, policy_sensitivity_beta)
  sample adoption_threshold ~ TruncatedNormal(adoption_threshold_mean, adoption_threshold_std, 0,1)
  assign is_influencer to fraction influencer_fraction (highest degree will be enforced later)
  assign is_anti_masker to fraction initial_anti_masker_fraction (set mask_attitude low)
  set adoption_state=1 for a random fraction initial_adoption_rate else 0
  create households sizes ~ PoissonShifted(household_size_mean)
  assign persons to households and create home_id, work_or_school_id stubs
  set habit_persistence for all persons
notes: PoissonShifted(k) ensures minimum 1.
is_anti_masker persons get initial mask_attitude near 0 and lower trust_in_authority.

modules.name: NetworkBuilder
modules.description: Builds the social network (small-world) and assigns work/school links. Increases degree for influencers.

update_rule.pseudocode:
on setup:
  if network_type == 'small_world':
    G = WattsStrogatz(n=population_size, k=network_avg_degree, p=network_rewiring_prob)
  increase degree for influencers:
    for each influencer:
      add connections to random nodes until degree >= influencer_degree_multiplier * network_avg_degree
  connect household members into cliques
  assign work_or_school_id by partitioning persons into num_work/school slots (done by EnvironmentBuilder)
notes: Household cliques raise clustering and peer influence.
Influencer extra edges simulate higher reach.

modules.name: EnvironmentBuilder
modules.description: Creates Location entities for work/school and public, assigns capacities, contact baselines, and maps persons to locations.

update_rule.pseudocode:
on setup:
  create work/school locations with capacity_work_school and baseline_contact_rate_work_school
  create public locations with capacity_public and baseline_contact_rate_public
  set enforcement_strictness by type parameters
  assign each person to a work_or_school_id if participating (prob ~ work_attendance_rate)
  set home locations = households
notes: Home capacity = household size; enforcement_strictness_home = 0.
Work participation probability is used again in mobility.

modules.name: MediaBroadcast
modules.description: Generates daily pro/neutral/anti messaging with channel credibility and reach; computes individual exposure effects.

update_rule.pseudocode:
each day:
  create channels: pro = max(0, 1 - misinformation_fraction - media_neutral_fraction), neutral = media_neutral_fraction, anti = misinformation_fraction
  for each person:
    draw messages ~ Poisson(message_frequency_per_day)
    for each message:
      sample channel by stance weighted by reach
      compute influence = channel.credibility * person.media_influence_sensitivity * person.trust_in_media
      if channel stance == 'pro': msg_effect += +influence
      if 'anti': msg_effect += -influence; record misinformation exposure
      if 'neutral': msg_effect += 0
    media.daily_exposure_shift[person] = clamp(msg_effect, -1, +1)
  observable.exposure_to_misinformation_daily = mean(probability of at least one anti exposure)
notes: Credibility sampled around media_credibility_mean daily or fixed per channel.
Exposure shift feeds into decision utility.

modules.name: PolicyController
modules.description: Activates/deactivates mandates, sets requires_masks at locations, and broadcasts guidance.

update_rule.pseudocode:
each day:
  mandate_active = (day >= mandate_start_day) and (day <= mandate_end_day)
  for each location type:
    locations.requires_masks_by_type[type] = mandate_active
  policy.guidance_signal = communication_intensity * (mandate_active ? +1 : -0.2)
notes: Guidance persists lightly negative post-mandate to simulate relaxed norms.
Enforcement rate and fines are consumed by LocationEnforcement.

modules.name: RiskSignal
modules.description: Computes daily perceived risk signal seen by all agents (e.g., epidemic wave).

update_rule.pseudocode:
each day:
  if perceived_risk_signal_type == 'wave':
    t = day + risk_wave_phase
    value = risk_baseline + perceived_risk_peak * max(0, sin(2*pi*t / risk_wave_period_days))
  else:
    value = risk_baseline
  risk_signal.value = clamp(value, 0, 1)
notes: This is an exogenous signal that modulates utility of masking.

modules.name: MobilityAndEncounters
modules.description: Simulates daily visits to home, work/school, public locations; produces encounter sets and observed local norms.

update_rule.pseudocode:
each day:
  for each person:
    schedule home visit (always)
    schedule work/school visit with prob work_attendance_rate
    schedule public visit with prob public_visit_rate
  within each visited location:
    sample contacts ~ Poisson(baseline_contact_rate_type * mobility_scaler_by_mix)
    record encountered peers (ids)
    compute observed_norm = fraction of masked among present last day (lagged) or current if immediate
    observed_norms.by_person[person] = weighted average by location_mix (loc_mix_home, loc_mix_work_school, loc_mix_public)
  encounters.today = list of contact pairs per person
notes: Observed norm is the perceived share of mask-wearers in local context.
Contact sampling constrained by capacity.

modules.name: LocationEnforcement
modules.description: Applies enforcement at locations with active mandates; computes immediate compliance and enforcement actions.

notes: Immediate compliance can override daily decision for specific visits.
Fines can feed back to person attitude if desired (not included here to keep separable).

modules.name: PeerInfluenceAndDecision
modules.description: Core decision module combining peers, media, policy guidance, perceived risk, habit, and disutility to choose daily mask use.

update_rule.pseudocode:
each day for each person i:
  peer_signal = observed_norms.by_person[i] (or neighborhood mean from network.graph if missing)
  media_signal = media.daily_exposure_shift[i]
  policy_signal = policy.guidance_signal
  risk_signal = risk_signal.value * (1 + i.risk_attitude)
  utility = peer_influence_weight * i.peer_influence_sensitivity * (2*peer_signal - 1)
          + media_influence_weight * i.media_influence_sensitivity * media_signal
          + policy_influence_weight * i.policy_influence_sensitivity * policy_signal
          + 0.3 * risk_signal
          - disutility_of_mask
          + i.habit_persistence * (2*prev_mask_use - 1)
  p_wear = sigmoid(utility / max(1e-6, decision_noise_scale))
  decision = Bernoulli(p_wear)
  if compliance.immediate_by_person[i] is True: decision = 1
  if compliance.immediate_by_person[i] is False: decision = 0
  person.current_mask_use[i] = decision
  update mask_attitude: i.mask_attitude = 0.9*i.mask_attitude + 0.1*(peer_signal + max(0, media_signal))/2
notes: sigmoid(x) = 1/(1+exp(-x)).
Habit persistence uses yesterday's mask use as prev_mask_use in {0,1}.
Disutility is subtracted as a constant cost of wearing.

modules.name: AdoptionAggregator
modules.description: Aggregates daily adoption and computes time-series observables and derived metrics (e.g., churn).

update_rule.pseudocode:
each day:
  adoption_rate = mean(person.current_mask_use)
  group_adoption_by_ses = {g: mean(mask_use | SES=g)}
  churn = (num who wore yesterday and not today) / max(1, num who wore yesterday)
  compliance_under_mandate_daily = adoption_rate if mandate_active else null
  smooth churn by moving average over churn_smoothing_window_days
  emit observables
notes: Stores entire time series for metric evaluation.
Group disparity computed later from group series.

modules.name: EnforcementTracker
modules.description: Tracks enforcement actions and computes per-1000 metric.

update_rule.pseudocode:
each day:
  per_1000 = 1000.0 * enforcement.actions_today / population_size
  observable.enforcement_actions_per_1000_daily = per_1000
notes: Assumes enforcement.actions_today counts warnings + fines.
